description: This file defines the OctoUtils class with static utility methods for handling blocks, duplicating block trees, and filter condition display strings within a web application, specifically related to a project involving blocks, board views, and filtering logic.

classes.name: OctoUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling blocks, duplicating block trees, and managing filter conditions within the application.

methods.name: hydrateBlock
methods.description: Creates a specific block instance based on the block's type.

methods.name: hydrateBlocks
methods.description: Hydrates an array of blocks by converting raw block data into block instances.

methods.name: mergeBlocks
methods.description: Merges two arrays of blocks, updating existing blocks and adding new ones.

methods.name: duplicateBlockTree
methods.description: Duplicates a tree of blocks, assigning new IDs and optionally remapping board and parent IDs.

methods.name: filterConditionDisplayString
methods.description: Returns a localized display string for a filter condition based on its type and value.

methods.name: filterConditionValidOrDefault
methods.description: Validates or defaults a filter condition based on the filter value type.
